name: LightPillar-TS-TW
title: Light Pillar
description: A tall column of violet light rises from the middle of a black stage, with a white-hot wavy core and a soft glow spreading sideways. It shimmers and turns slowly without ever breaking apart.
use: A dark page wants one commanding vertical light behind a title or product shot.
avoid: A narrow bright column pulls the eye and fights text placed over it without a scrim.
a11y: A canvas backdrop with no labels; its endless shimmer ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall column of violet light rises through the middle of a near-black stage, brightest at the centre and fading outward into soft pink haze. A jagged white filament runs up the spine of the pillar.
behaves: The column breathes and shimmers, the inner filament writhing while the glow around it slowly turns. The pillar sways gently but never breaks apart.
customise: Top and bottom colours, intensity, rotation speed, glow, pillar width and height, noise and quality are props; the ray-marched shape is fixed.
weight: heavy: A ray-marched shader with up to 80 iterations per pixel on every frame.
